video.title: CLAUDE CODE ADVANCED FULL COURSE (3 HOURS)

summary: The video titled "CLAUDE CODE ADVANCED FULL COURSE" is designed for advanced users of Claude Code, particularly those who are already familiar with its functionalities and want to enhance their skills. The course, led by an experienced instructor who uses Claude Code in his own business, covers a wide range of advanced topics, including optimizing system prompts, building larger projects, managing agent teams, and improving workflow organization. Viewers will learn how to effectively utilize Claude Code to boost productivity, manage projects, and handle performance fluctuations, ultimately walking away with practical knowledge to apply in their own personal or business contexts. The course emphasizes hands-on learning with real use cases, making it a valuable resource for those looking to maximize their use of Claude Code.
